ledgers.caveat: Numerical payload only; finite-bit quantization is not simulated. Center model/waveform availability and star unicast are assumptions. Explicit model downlink is the total across both receivers per update; zero means omitted, not free. Cached templates exclude historical acquisition. Calibration, framing, timestamps, computation, RF chains, topology, latency and energy are excluded.
